title: Boarding host capability: five answers, then five matching constraints
method: Regressions written and observed RED before the production change (12 of 12 failing), then GREEN; two delegation cases added as the wiring landed. Six sabotage reversions.

measured_before.nothing_collected_them: boarding_host_profiles carries all five columns and the only writers in the repository were a hardcoded seed and a demo SQL file, so a real host could never be boarded. This is the gap PTJA-P1 recorded as 'unbuilt feature, needs product decisions'.
measured_before.activation_checked_existence_only: The activation gate required a profile ROW to exist, not that it said anything. A row with no service area, an empty species list and zero capacity passed, and the host went live to be matched on declarations nobody had ever made.
measured_before.medication_was_read_by_nothing: medication_support appeared in the seed and in a badge display and NOWHERE else. A host who cannot give medication was matched to a pet that needs it, every time.
measured_before.one_family_fired_too_late: It was enforced at stay ACCEPTANCE but not at booking, which turns a matching decision into a failed handover after the customer has paid.

approved_rules_implemented.five_answers_before_active: saveBoardingHostCapability refuses an incomplete set outright rather than storing a half-profile - a row that exists but says nothing is exactly what let the old gate through. assertBoardingHostCapabilityComplete blocks activation and names which answers are missing.
approved_rules_implemented.answered_is_not_the_same_as_true: 'This host does not give medication' is information a matcher can use; 'nobody asked' is not, and both would otherwise be stored as 0. The write path takes booleans and refuses null, and capabilityGapsFrom treats NULL as unanswered while 0 is an answer.
approved_rules_implemented.service_area_covers_the_location: Matched on city and zone, which is the covering unit this platform matches on. `area` is the human label an operator reads and is required as an ANSWER, not used as a geographic test - inventing area geometry would be inventing product.
approved_rules_implemented.species_matches_the_pet: Unsupported species are named in the refusal.
approved_rules_implemented.available_capacity: Occupied places count against declared capacity, so a host with three places and two guests has one - the previous check compared against the declared number alone.
approved_rules_implemented.one_family_only_when_enabled: Fires only where the host set it, and only against a DIFFERENT family. Sabotage D makes it universal and BH-09 goes red.
approved_rules_implemented.medication_only_when_needed: Fires only when a pet on the booking needs medication. Sabotage C makes it a universal rejection - which would shrink supply for no safety gain - and BH-10 goes red.
approved_rules_implemented.the_signal_that_makes_it_possible: canonical-bookings pets now carry medicationRequired. Without that signal the constraint could never fire, so the rule would have been unimplementable rather than merely unimplemented.

what_this_work_did_NOT_do.no_new_identity_requirements: No police or government-ID requirement is introduced for Boarding. BH-12 asserts the capability module never mentions one and that the police floor in lib/provider-verification-policy.ts is still exactly Dog Walking and Pet Taxi.
what_this_work_did_NOT_do.existing_boarding_verification_untouched: Boarding's home_verified / kyc_status / background_check_status checks predate this work and are left exactly as they are. Removing them would be weakening a control; extending them to other verticals would be adding one. Neither is in scope.

a_correction_to_my_own_test: BH-14 was written to prove the booking gate refuses a medication booking, and refused for the wrong reason - governBoardingBooking checks the quote before the host, so the case was passing on 'A valid server Boarding quote is required'. It now creates a real quote first and asserts the refusal names medication.

sabotage_verification: A incomplete answers accepted -> BH-01 red
B medication constraint removed -> BH-10, BH-14 red
C medication becomes a universal rejection -> BH-10 red
D one-family becomes universal -> BH-09 red
E activation gate back to row-exists -> BH-05 red
F booking gate stops delegating -> BH-13, BH-14 red

a_note_on_a_flaky_run: tests/lane2-core-integration-boundaries.test.mjs reported two failing cases in one full-suite run while the run's own counter said fail 0, and the suite passed alone and on the next full run. Recorded rather than quietly re-run. It is the second intermittent seen on this branch; both are in suites that spin up heavier fixtures.

still_open_and_not_claimed.onboarding_ui: saveBoardingHostCapability is the writer. No onboarding screen or route calls it yet, so today the five answers must come through the library. Wiring the host-onboarding form is follow-up work.
still_open_and_not_claimed.area_geometry: Service-area matching is by zone. If the business later wants sub-zone or radius matching for hosts, `area` is where that would live and this is not it.
still_open_and_not_claimed.medication_declaration: medicationRequired is taken from the booking's pets. Nothing yet stores it on the canonical pet record, so a repeat customer re-declares it each time.
